items.title: 6.3.1.3 Machine Learning and AI in the Cloud (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ML and AI in the cloud (PDF 160).

blocks.text: Cloud machine learning aur AI banane aur chalane ke taqatwar auzaar deti hai. Google Cloud AI aur AWS SageMaker machine learning models banane, train aur deploy karne ke platforms dete hain, to data scientists ko bare local computing wasail ki zaroorat nahi.

blocks.prompt: AI model school ke computer ki bajaye cloud mein kyun train karein?
blocks.explanation: Training ko thore waqt ke liye bohat computing taqat chahiye; cloud mehnga hardware khareedne ki bajaye zaroorat par kiraye par deti hai.

items: Cloud ML aur AI: bare local hardware ke baghair models banana, train aur deploy (Google Cloud AI, SageMaker).
